# datagecko_series (Resource)

One line of points, belonging to a stream.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datagecko_series" "delivery" {
  stream_id = datagecko_stream.revenue.id
  name      = "delivery"
  unit      = "USD"
}

resource "datagecko_series" "deployed" {
  stream_id     = datagecko_stream.revenue.id
  name          = "deployed"
  kind          = "marker" # shown as a value, never plotted; cannot change after creation
  interval_days = 7        # declared cadence; freshness measures days behind net of it
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique within the stream. Must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$.
- `stream_id` (String) The stream this series belongs to. A series cannot move between streams.

### Optional

- `interval_days` (Number) The series' declared cadence in days, 1-366; unset means none. Freshness measures days behind net of it.
- `kind` (String) measure or marker. A marker's points are shown as values, never plotted. Set at creation; a change replaces the series.
- `unit` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The series' UUID.
- `last_point_at` (String) RFC 3339, or empty if no point has ever landed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By <stream id>/<series id>.
terraform import datagecko_series.delivery 4f1c6a3e-.../9b2d7e10-...
```
